sloka: सुमहन् नो बलम् कस्माद् विषादम् भजते भवान् ।त्वया भोगवतीम् गत्वा निर्जताः पन्नगा युधि ॥६-७-३॥।।
transliteration: sumahan no balam kasmād viṣādam bhajate bhavān ।tvayā bhogavatīm gatvā nirjatāḥ pannagā yudhi ॥6-7-3॥।।

translations.english: The Lord of Rakshasas having spoken like that, to the Rakshasas, who were very strong, but ignorant about the enemy's strength and who were not endowed with political wisdom, spoke to Ravana, the king of Rakshasas, the following words with folded hands.
translations.hindi: जाला १ अस्मिन्न-“लक्ानिरोधनरूपे कार्ये । (गो०) हे राजन्‌ ! हम लोगों के पास परिघ, शक्ति, यष्टि, शूल और पटाधारिणी एक महती सेना है । अतः आप विषाद क्यों करते हें
